request.deadline: Instantly performed as part of governance action enactment on-chain
deliverables: Instant on-chain treasury withdrawal to reimburse the lost Info governance action deposit
Additional compensation for estimated lost staking rewards
request.recipient: Ikigai Info governance action submitter; exact recipient address not stated in document
request.what: Reimburse the submitter of the Ikigai Info governance action for an unrecovered governance action deposit plus estimated lost staking rewards.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 103,000 ADA from the treasury to reimburse a 100,000 ADA lost governance action deposit plus 3,000 ADA for estimated lost staking rewards.
The original Ikigai Info governance action was submitted in September 2024 shortly after the Chang hard fork and was symbolic in nature.
The submitter could not recover the 100,000 ADA deposit because a Cardano node bug permitted an unregistered stake key to be used in the governance action.
The community expressed significant sentiment at the time that the Ikigai deposit should be reimbursed.
The Cardano in Oceania initiative included this reimbursement in its budget Info governance action, but that governance action was not approved.
The requested 3,000 ADA staking-reward compensation is calculated at a rate of 2% per annum.
The proposal states that the recipient has not previously received funds from the treasury.
The proposal states that the requested withdrawal does not exceed the current Net Change Limit.
The proposal says distribution can be audited on-chain because funds will be made directly available to the intended recipient.
The proposal provides an external governance reference URL for the prior Ikigai governance action.

summary: The document seeks a 103,000 ADA treasury reimbursement for a claimed unrecoverable governance action deposit caused by a node bug, with limited supporting detail beyond narrative assertions and one external governance reference.
